title: Chouinard (2007)「Children's Questions: A Mechanism for Cognitive Development」

source.title: Children's Questions: A Mechanism for Cognitive Development
source.version_note: Monographs of the Society for Research in Child Development, 72(1), 1-129 (March 2007)。ERIC EJ835244（公開抄録・As Provided）と Wiley の DOI ランディングで書誌を照合。DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-5834.2007.00412.x。

passage: 【編者による要約】Four studies argue that children's questions function as an Information Requesting Mechanism (IRM): Study 1 (four children's CHILDES transcripts, age 1;2-5;1) shows children ask many information-seeking questions, receive informative answers, and keep asking when answers are uninformative; Study 2 (diaries kept by 68 parents, children aged 1;0-5;0) extends information recruiting to preverbal gesture and vocalization; Study 3 (112 parent-child dyads walking through one of three zoos) shows the type of stimulus changes how deep the questions go; Study 4 (67 four-year-olds in a hidden-object task) shows children allowed to ask questions were significantly more likely to identify the hidden object, drawing on conceptual rather than merely perceptual information.
context: ERIC の公開抄録全文（研究1〜4の設計と主要結果）と Wiley の DOI ランディングを fetch_page で取得して照合した。モノグラフ本文（全129頁）は未取得。既知の頻度統計（例：毎時76問・情報追求約81%）は本文由来で未照合のため、本行の passage には転記していない。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261124-6622b8（発達方向の符号反転説）の土台——質問の量・型・刺激・因果利用が 研究ごとに別の観測で現れることを示す一次資料。割当対 HYP-20261120-58ddce vs HYP-20261119-539a0c の人間側について、知識状態の隙間に質問を差し込む仕組み（IRM）が因果利用（Study 4）まで含めて記述されている点を拾う。HYP-20261125-d74ea8（自発検索トリガー）との接続候補。

title: Degotardi, Brand, Djonov & Sweller (2025)「From 'what' to 'why': plotting the emergence and frequency of children's questions from 30 to 42 months of age」

source.title: From 'what' to 'why': plotting the emergence and frequency of children's questions from 30 to 42 months of age
source.version_note: Early Education and Development。オンライン公開2025-08-19、号版 (2026) 34(6): 949-964。OA（CC BY-NC-ND）。DOI: 10.1080/1350293X.2025.2548293。年はオンライン公開年（2025）で記録。

passage: At 30 months, specify questions were used by 75% of the children, rising to 92% by 42 months of age. Confirm questions were only used by 19% of children at 30 months, but emerged rapidly so that over 52% of children had demonstrated a first use by 36 months and 85% by 42 months. Explain questions emerged later and more gradually, being absent at 30 months, rising to 26% at 36 months, and 65% by 42 months of age. ... More informative is how children's patterns of question use changed over time, with the proportion of specify questions significantly decreasing, while the proportion of explain significantly increased as the children got older.
context: ECEC 環境の27人児を30→42ヶ月で縦断（各時点72-75観察、10分あたり頻度と全質問に占める比例を線形混合モデル）。出現率は specify44.5%→92%、confirm14.5%→89%、explain3.5%（30ヶ月）→65%（42ヶ月）。比例の型×年齢交互作用 χ2(8)=58.53, p<.001。specify の線形トレンド z=-3.69, p<.001（負）、explain は z=3.61, p<.001（正）、confirm は z=1.51, p=.130（非有意）。総頻度の年齢効果は非有意 χ2(4)=8.93, p=.06。42ヶ月でも explain を使わない子どもが35%。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261124-6622b8（発達方向の符号反転説）に正面から当たる縦断資料——総頻度は非有意のまま、型の比例は specify 負・explain 正へ符号が割れる。割当対 HYP-20261120-58ddce vs HYP-20261119-539a0c の発達方向の記述が、質問の型を選ぶだけで符号反転しうることを示す。HYP-20261126-4e5813（三相発達説）の「型の分化こそ発達」の要旨にも一次資料として接続。

title: Ruggeri & Lombrozo (2015)「Children adapt their questions to achieve efficient search」

source.title: Children adapt their questions to achieve efficient search
source.version_note: Cognition, 143, 203-216 (October 2015)。ScienceDirect の公開アブストラクト・ハイライト・導入節スニペットを linkinghub.elsevier.com 経由で照合。Study 1/2 の方法・結果本文はElsevier の購読壁により未取得。DOI: 10.1016/j.cognition.2015.07.004。

passage: 【編者による要約】Across 7-8-year-olds, 9-11-year-olds and 17-18-year-olds asking questions to identify the cause of an event, children's reliance shifts from hypothesis-scanning toward constraint-seeking questions with age, yet all age groups ask more constraint-seeking questions exactly when scanning is least likely to pay off: when the solution is one among equally likely alternatives (Study 1) or when the problem is difficult (Studies 1 and 2) — the first demonstration that even young children dynamically adapt their strategies for inquiry to increase the efficiency of information search.
context: ScienceDirect のハイライト5項目・アブストラクト全文・導入節（Mosher & Hornsby の20問ゲーム系譜、仮説スキャン対制約探索の定義、期待情報利得への感度の記述）を取得。因果帰因課題（例：遅刻の理由探し）で質問型を選ぶ設計。

title: Ünlütabak, Nicolopoulou & Aksu-Koç (2019)「Questions asked by Turkish preschoolers from middle-SES and low-SES families」

source.title: Questions asked by Turkish preschoolers from middle-SES and low-SES families
source.version_note: Cognitive Development, 52, 100802 (October-December 2019)。特別号 Cultural Pathways in Cognitive Development。ScienceDirect の公開ハイライト・アブストラクトを照合。DOI: 10.1016/j.cogdev.2019.100802。

passage: 【編者による要約】In an experimental context with pictures of unfamiliar animals and objects, 105 Turkish 3-5-year-olds (55 middle-SES, 50 low-SES) asked mostly fact-seeking rather than explanation-seeking questions, asked more information-seeking questions after informative than non-informative answers, and showed SES differences: middle-SES children asked more information-seeking questions (the difference most pronounced for fact-seeking), while explanation-seeking questions were less frequent than in previous Western samples (22% middle-SES and 10% low-SES, versus 26-30% in Western samples).
context: ScienceDirect の abs ページを fetch_page で取得（6チャンク中0）。ハイライト4項目とアブストラクト全文：N=105（middle-SES55・low-SES50）、3-5歳、不熟な動物・物体の絵提示、情報性/非情報性応答条件で質問の型と数を測定。説明追求質問の比率が欧米サンプル（26-30%）より低い。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261124-6622b8（発達方向の符号反転説）の「語りの文脈・標本の選択で符号反転」を、トルコの SES×説明質問率（22%/10% 対 欧米26-30%）で照合するため。割当対 HYP-20261120-58ddce vs HYP-20261119-539a0c の質量が WEIRD 標本に依存するかの境界資料。
